normalization: fully normalized (geodesy 4-pi), per the PDS label and header NORMALIZATION STATE = 1
frame: Moon principal axes (PA) of the DE430 ephemeris, per the PDS label ("The planetary ephemeris used is de430 and defines the lunar body-fixed coordinate system in the principal axes frame")
tide_system: not stated in the label; the label gives the nominal Love number k2 = 0.024133 +/- 0.000010 (no tide model is applied in src/prop.js)
order: C and S listed by degree n = 0..N, then order m = 0..n (index n(n+1)/2 + m); C00 = 1, degree 1 = 0
